gen-dafont-over-there-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Barracks-poster swagger: Over There looks drawn with a fixed-width nib, glyphs spaced generously apart. Pilcrow Rounded does the warm, quiet work with tightly packed letters and big counters, while the heading simply gives orders.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-david-libre: Vintage-military and commanding, Over There looks drawn by a fixed-width nib. David Libre, the dignified text serif, its terminals hanging open, handles refined reading; the heading is built for shouting a line.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-gentium-plus: Commanding Over There leans vintage-military, its nib-drawn letters spaced generously. Gentium Plus is the draw here: a refined body whose c opens like a pitcher's wide mouth, leading the eye along one thread.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-gowun-batang: Spaghetti-line swagger: Over There lays out vintage-military letters, drawn with a fixed-width nib. Gowun Batang, the refined text serif, leaves a big gap at each cut-back terminal, so extended reading feels literary and unhurried.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-habibi: Habibi sets a clear channel into each round letter, giving it a traditional, editorial voice. Then Over There, rounds and stems in one weight, barks above it while the text underneath reads on smoothly.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-kay-pho-du: Parade-ground presence: Over There looks nib-drawn and commanding, with generous gaps between letters. Kay Pho Du is a traditional serif whose counters breathe like a hollow reed, and its rolling-ball-pen line keeps extended reading relaxed.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-montaga: Drill-hall confidence: Over There, nib-drawn and generously spaced, plays the vintage-military voice. Montaga, bookish and editorial, is where the pair is strongest, its pen-lifted curves leaving loops unfinished like thread stitched along a path.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-yuji-boku: Dignified Yuji Boku holds each stroke to one thickness, like drawn cable. Over There commands the top in vintage-military style, while the bracelet-open c in Yuji Boku lets the text breathe below.
gen-dafont-over-there-nunito-sans: Soft open-mouthed curves in Nunito Sans meet Over There, whose vintage-military letters look drawn with a fixed-width nib. Paragraphs in the sans feel gentle and easygoing, never pushing back.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-abyssinica-sil: Geometric and technical, Ozone keeps stems and crossbars at one thickness. Abyssinica SIL, the literary text serif, thins its arches slightly where they leave the stem, giving Ozone's unthinned strokes a gentler partner.
